column25: Career Ready Practices (Required All CTE — not reported in CTEIS)

column2: Unit Title
Career Ready Practices — Engineering Careers & Financial Literacy
column32: Integrated with Unit 6 (Career Readiness) as ongoing work throughout the year. D1.0 Start-of-Year Checklist launches career exploration in Week 1; Unit 6 deliverables extend through the year. BLS.gov career research + paycheck/budget analysis + written reflection. PM1 coverage pending confirmation with counseling dept — see GAPS.

column2: Engineering Design Process
column31: Paper glider / spaghetti tower / design brief / decision matrix / Pugh Matrix. EDP = B1–B3–B7 loop. ~2 weeks. Note: C1 and C4 removed — were data entry errors in prior version.

column2: CAD, 3D Printing & Rapid Prototyping
column30: Fusion 360: sketching → 3D modeling → assemblies → technical drawings. 3D printing: slicing, queue, print iteration with calipers. CNC router introduction. Component-based robot CAD (C1–C7 components). Version naming. Rapid Prototyping was a separate unit in prior crosswalk — now fully integrated. C7 partial (3D solid modeling only; simulation not yet implemented). ~7–9 weeks.

column2: Shop Safety & Standard Practices
column31: OSHA / LOTO / PPE / SDS / safety contract. Tool certification required before build phase. ~1 week.

column2: Programming & Robotics (MicroPython)
column31: MicroPython on Raspberry Pi Pico 2W. Variables / loops / conditionals / functions / classes. Motor control. IR sensors / ultrasonic distance / line following / PID control. Combines former crosswalk Units 5 (Programming) + 6 (Sensors & Robot Behaviors). Language updated from C++ to MicroPython. ~14 weeks.

column2: AI & Machine Learning
column31: Teachable Machine: image classification — data collection, model training, testing, iteration. AI ethics and societal implications written reflection. Computer vision basics. PM2: explicit career connection to AI/ML fields.

column2: Career Readiness
column31: Ongoing throughout year. Career exploration (BLS.gov engineering + trades), paycheck/budget analysis, portfolio reflections connecting student work to career pathways. Deliverables: career brief, financial literacy activity, portfolio reflection. Framework established in Unit 0.

column2: Electrical Systems
column31: Multimeter lab (voltage / current / resistance / continuity). Breadboards. LED circuits + current-limiting resistor calculations. Ohm's Law (V=IR). Series vs. parallel circuits. Equivalent resistance. Kirchhoff's Voltage and Current Laws. ~2 weeks.

column2: Mechanisms
column31: Simple machines + IMA calculations. Mechanical advantage (IMA vs. AMA). Pulley systems. Gear ratios + multi-stage gear trains. Tug of War design challenge (design → build → test). Servo Build Project (design brief → fabricate → demonstrate). Primary C3 coverage unit. ~6 weeks.

column2: Capstone Project
column30: Portfolio reflections R1/R2/R3. Community Engineering / Applied Fabrication / Creative Fabrication tracks. Professional presentation + sustainability reflection.

column2: FIRST Robotics Competition
column30: Reserved for Year 2 — accountability and FIRST season timing coordination needed before re-integrating as coursework.
